# GadgetBid

> Nigerian gadget auction marketplace with real-time bidding, escrow, and seller payouts.

Public site: https://www.gadgetsbidding.com
App: GadgetBid mobile apps (package com.gadgetbid.app)
Operations: https://admin.gadgetsbidding.com
API: https://api.gadgetsbidding.com

## Contact

- Support: support@gadgetsbidding.com
- Locality: Lagos, Nigeria

## Product

- English auctions for phones, laptops, and other gadgets priced in Naira
- Wallet funding and payouts via Paystack
- Escrow for winning bids until delivery confirmation
- Seller listing review before auctions go live
